Thanks for contributing! Keep it short but specific — reviewers should not
need to read the diff to understand the intent. Delete sections that do not
apply.
-->

## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. What behaviour is different after this PR? -->

## Why

<!-- The problem, bug report, or task this addresses. Link issues: Closes #123 -->

## How I tested it

<!--
Be concrete: commands you ran, pages you clicked, scenarios you checked.
"Tested locally" on its own is not enough.
-->

## Type of change

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests / tooling / CI

## Author checklist

- [ ] I worked on my own branch (not `main`) and this PR targets `main`
- [ ] The branch name follows the convention (`feature/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…`, `chore/…`)
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q src tests` passes
- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m pytest -q`), or I have explained why there are none
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, tokens, `.env` files, or local database dumps are committed
- [ ] I have not reformatted or renamed unrelated files
- [ ] I read the diff myself before requesting review

## Screenshots / output

<!-- UI changes: before and after. Backend changes: relevant logs or query output. -->

## Reviewer notes

<!-- Anything you are unsure about, or where you want a second opinion. -->
